# Boost.Regex

Upstream: https://github.com/boostorg/regex
Version: boost-1.90.0
Commit: f439e22ae41fa647bd7de16c2d92deb232593985
License: Boost Software License 1.0 (LICENSE_1_0.txt)

Unmodified upstream include/ tree, built in header-only standalone mode.
Only the headers are vendored; tests, documentation and the deprecated POSIX C API are omitted.
Search integration and UTF-8 position mapping live in src/SearchOptions.cpp.
